Tooltip_HardcoreMode: Override the main save instead of using separate autosave slots.
Tooltip_MaxSaveFiles:
Total autosave slots per playthrough.
Must be at least 1.
Tooltip_AutosaveOnTimer: Autosave every X minutes as defined under Autosave Conditions.
Tooltip_DelaySaveOnManual: Reset the next autosave timing when the player performs a manual save.
Tooltip_MinutesBetweenAutosaves:
Time (in minutes) to wait between autosaves.
Must be at least 1.
Tooltip_AutosaveOnSleep: Autosave when the player goes to sleep.
AutosaveErrorReport: Please report this issue to the mod author, including log
Tooltip_SaveWhilePiloting: Enable autosaves while driving vehicles such as Seamoth or PRAWN suit. May cause glitches, especially with modules such as the Grappling Arm. Use at your own risk.
Tooltip_ShowSaveMessages: Display messages, such as warning about autosaves.
Tooltip_AutosaveWarningTime: Control when the autosave warning message appears. Default: 30 seconds before autosave.
Tooltip_MinimumPlayerHealthPercent:
Delay save if player health is below this percent.
Change to 0 to disable this option.
Tooltip_ShowSaveNames: Show slot names in the main menu loading screen.
Tooltip_UseCustomDateFormat: Use custom saved game date-time in the main menu.
Tooltip_CustomDateTimeFormat: If enabled, choose how save dates are shown.
Tooltip_QuicksaveKey:
Keybinding used to save the game manually.
Same functionality as saving through the ingame menu.
AutosaveInProgress: Autosave in progress. Cannot autosave again right now.
